findings.title: Task completion can prematurely end dispatch
findings.description: An empty task ledger does not mean the parent’s follow-up turn has finished. If a task notification arrives before the original result, this branch returns immediately, leaving the injected continuation unread. I reproduced this: the first dispatch returned “Waiting for report.”; the next dispatch discarded “Wrote artifact.” as leftover text. Artifact validation can therefore run before the artifact is written. Track pending continuations/session completion separately and test this message ordering.

findings.title: Model switching bypasses the unusable-session guard
findings.description: DispatchAction calls `set_model()` before `dispatch()`, but only the latter checks `unusable_reason`. After a failed reconnect, a subsequent step with a concrete model reaches the disconnected client instead of reporting the recorded failure. I verified it raises `CLIConnectionError: Not connected. Call connect() first.`, losing the original reconnect diagnosis. Guard `set_model()` too, and cover this through the real action path.

findings.title: Background-session changes lack required load coverage
findings.description: The new tests exercise short scripted streams, but no load test covers sustained background notifications, concurrent activity, or bounded cleanup latency. The existing `tests/load/` tests cover grep and worktrees only. Add a realistic session-stream load test asserting latency or resource bounds, as required for changes on network/concurrency paths.
